rows.issue: Pages hidden from Google (noindex/nofollow): confirm intent
rows.what_to_do: Confirm each hidden page is meant to be (legal pages, thank-you pages and press releases usually are); record the answer in rules.decisions. Ahrefs issues folded in: Nofollow page, Noindex and nofollow page, Noindex follow page, Noindex page.

rows.issue: Orphan page (has no incoming internal links)
rows.what_to_do: Per page: link it from somewhere relevant, noindex it, or merge/delete it. Catalog sites (mooringtech 4.7k) need a look at how the catalog is linked first.

rows.issue: Orphan page (has no incoming internal links)  (non-indexable pages)
rows.what_to_do: Per page: link it from somewhere relevant, noindex it, or merge/delete it. Catalog sites (mooringtech 4.7k) need a look at how the catalog is linked first.
Not page weight if HTML is small: run PageSpeed/WebPageTest on the top 3 by traffic and the host's APM; deep pagination = cold cache. Hosting or theme ticket.
Template edit: add an <h1> to the archive/post-type template the triage names; diff goes in changes/<provider>/<slug>/ for a human to apply.

rows.issue: Structured data has schema.org validation error
rows.what_to_do: Run the top page through the Schema Markup Validator to get the failing property; hand-coded blocks in the theme (hsfamilylaw's LegalService) are a template edit.

rows.issue: H1 tag missing or empty  (non-indexable pages)
rows.what_to_do: Template edit: add an <h1> to the archive/post-type template the triage names; diff goes in changes/<provider>/<slug>/ for a human to apply.
Two things print <title>: find the second (theme header, builder, plugin) once per site and remove it; usually one setting.

rows.issue: Slow server response for AI crawlers
rows.what_to_do: TTFB. Check which pages: deep pagination = cold cache (raise products-per-page); single pages at 5 s+ = PHP, run the host's APM.
Two things print <title>: find the second (theme header, builder, plugin) once per site and remove it; usually one setting.
